criteria: Familiar standalone English word with a coherent ordinary meaning.
Several related guesses provide a fair semantic path to the answer.
Family-safe and not needlessly upsetting, sexual, offensive, or identity-targeting.
Not mainly grammar, dialogue filler, a proper name, a demonym, an awkward inflection, or a weaker duplicate.
Concrete and vivid words are preferred; clear abstract concepts remain eligible.

targets.reviewOverride: Common profession with a clear medical semantic neighborhood.
Common natural feature with a clear water and geography semantic neighborhood.
Common sport with a clear team, ball, and competition semantic neighborhood.
